# Munal AI — LLMs.txt
# https://munal.ai
# Last updated: 2026-04-15

> Munal AI is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered workforce management and collaboration platform built by Jiffix Inc. It replaces multiple workplace tools with a single integrated system — combining AI meeting transcription, smart shift scheduling, eSignatures, document management, real-time chat, video conferencing, and workflow automation.

## Core Capabilities

### AI Meeting Summaries & Transcription
- Real-time meeting transcription powered by OpenAI Whisper
- GPT-5.2-powered automatic meeting summaries with action items, decisions, and follow-ups
- One-click email delivery of formatted meeting summaries to all participants
- AI-generated meeting agendas based on past meetings and open action items
- Ideal for clinical and administrative leadership alignment in healthcare settings

### Smart Shift Management
- Visual drag-and-drop shift scheduler with day, week, and month views
- Automated shift reminders via email and push notifications
- Shift swap requests with manager approval workflows
- Real-time coverage tracking and gap alerts
- Perfect for medical staff rotations, nursing schedules, and support team coordination

### eSignatures & Multi-Step Approvals
- Legally binding digital signatures with full audit trails
- Multi-step approval workflows with sequential and parallel routing
- Template-based document generation for recurring processes
- Supports patient intake forms, administrative compliance, and regulatory documentation

### DocHub — Centralized Document Management
- Secure, centralized storage for all organizational documents
- PDF editor, file converter (PDF, DOCX, XLSX), and annotation tools
- Version control and access permissions
- Ideal for medical records, strategy documentation, and compliance files

### Text-to-Video & Text-to-Audio
- AI-powered video generation from text prompts (Sora 2)
- Text-to-speech audio generation for announcements and training materials
- Quick internal staff training content creation
- Health announcement and patient education video generation

### AI Hub (5 AI Tools)
- AI Smart Search: Natural language search across all workspace data
- AI Document Summarizer: Upload PDFs and get instant summaries
- AI Meeting Agenda Generator: Auto-generate structured agendas
- AI Weekly Digest: Personalized weekly summary emails
- AI Chat: Conversational AI assistant for workspace queries

### Smart Spreadsheets
- AI-powered spreadsheet with formula assistance
- Auto-generated charts and dashboards
- XLSX export and template library
- Data insights panel with trend analysis

### Real-Time Communication
- Instant messaging with file sharing, reactions, and threading
- Voice chat channels for quick team communication
- Video conferencing with screen sharing
- Push notifications across web and mobile

### Enterprise Security
- AES-256 encryption for data at rest and in transit
- Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP + Email OTP)
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions
- Full audit logging and compliance reporting
- SOC 2 and HIPAA-aligned security practices

### Calendar & Scheduling
- Integrated calendar with meeting scheduling
- Recurring events and reminders
- Time zone support for distributed teams

### Admin Dashboard
- Comprehensive admin portal with user management
- System analytics and usage monitoring
- Organization-level controls and policies
- Module permission management

## Industry Solutions

### Healthcare
Munal AI streamlines clinical and administrative workflows with HIPAA-aligned security, AI meeting summaries for leadership alignment, smart shift scheduling for medical staff rotations, eSignatures for patient intake, and DocHub for centralized medical records.

### Education
Schools and universities use Munal AI for faculty meeting transcription, class scheduling, digital forms for enrollment, document management for academic records, and AI-powered training content creation.

### Legal
Law firms leverage Munal AI for client meeting transcription, document management with version control, eSignatures for contracts, multi-step approval workflows, and encrypted file storage for sensitive case materials.

### Finance
Financial institutions use Munal AI for compliance meeting documentation, shift management for branch operations, secure document storage with AES-256 encryption, approval workflows for financial processes, and audit trail reporting.

## Technical Details
- Platform: Web (React), iOS, Android (Capacitor)
- Backend: Python FastAPI
- AI: OpenAI GPT-5.2, Whisper, Sora 2
- Security: AES-256, bcrypt, JWT, 2FA
- Database: MongoDB Atlas
- Pricing: Free, Pro ($19/mo), Business ($39/mo), Enterprise ($79/mo)
